items.title: DAVID BEDNAR: The Mormon Apostle Who's Actually a Robot 🤖 | Industrial Metal Parody
items.summary: A short video from the Mormon News Roundup YouTube channel.

items.title: Faith, Fraud, and Fake Cancer: The Coco Berthmann Story
items.summary: Generally Unquotable examines the story of Coco Berthmann, whose account of a miraculous conversion to the church was shared widely in Latter-day Saint circles before people began asking questions about it.

items.title: Latest from Mormon Land: Gender gap again shows up in the church; LDS voters ride the blue wave
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune's Mormon Land newsletter reports on a By Common Consent blogger who argues the church's coming youth program changes offer Young Men more meaningful participation than Young Women, and on Latter-day Saint voters shifting toward Democrats in the midterms.

items.title: Your Tithing Dollars at Work
items.summary: A Wheat & Tares post says that, from a purely fiscal perspective, the author has gotten a good return on his tithing, citing a mission, schooling and graduate funding that the church helped provide.

items.title: My Wife is Going to Hell, but my Pedophile Brother-in-law is Going to the Celestial Kingdom
items.summary: An r/exmormon post claims that under Mormon doctrine the poster's wife, who resigned her membership, is bound for hell while a brother-in-law the poster says abused children and was rebaptized before he died is bound for the celestial kingdom.

items.title: Zion will have data centers
items.summary: A Times & Seasons post argues that Jesus would build data centers for AI workloads, saying God has favored cities and that city-building has required large-scale infrastructure.
